Knowledge Base: Deploying the Reporting Add-on

System Requirements

The reporting add-on requires at least 4 GB of available RAM, a modern
browser (Chrome, Edge, or Firefox, last two major versions), and network
access to the company's internal API gateway.

System Architecture Overview

The add-on runs as a browser extension that talks to the reporting service
over HTTPS. No data is stored locally beyond the current session's cache,
which clears automatically on logout.

Installation

Download the add-on package from the internal software portal and follow
the platform-specific installer. Restart your browser after installation
to complete setup.

Troubleshooting

If reports fail to load, first check that you are on the corporate VPN.
If the issue persists, clear the extension's cache from its settings page
and reload.
